projects.title: Engineering work
projects.subtitle: Selected engineering cases — study repos and experiments. Private production work is documented in About.

showcase.lead: Each case states intent, architecture, and engineering trade-off. Private production work is not listed here — see Experience in About.

projects.sectionLead: Study and open-source cases with honest scope. Industrial production work lives in About.

default.framing: Study or experiment — scope, constraints, and what was practiced in the repository.
default.architecture: Layered UI with typed boundaries between views, state, and API or static data.
default.decision: Favor legibility, honest loading/error states, and maintainable composition over visual noise.

ReactGram.framing: Study case: social feed and messaging to rehearse Socket.io lifecycle, presence, and optimistic UI — patterns useful in production realtime UIs.
ReactGram.architecture: React client with dedicated stores; FastAPI service; Socket.io as primary transport with explicit reconnect handling.
ReactGram.decision: Treat connection state as part of the UI contract, not a background detail.

netflix_clone.framing: Study case: streaming-style catalog to practice horizontal rails, density breakpoints, and scroll performance without a UI kit.
netflix_clone.architecture: Layered CSS layout, lazy media loading, route-driven catalog views.
netflix_clone.decision: Measure scroll and composition before adding visual effects.

movies_lib.framing: Study case: film catalog SPA focused on REST boundaries, loading states, and list/detail navigation.
movies_lib.architecture: Vite + React; typed API layer; explicit error and skeleton paths.
movies_lib.decision: Ship honest empty and error surfaces — same discipline as production dashboards.

secret_word.framing: Study case: word-guessing game to practice component state, keyboard input, and win/lose flows.
secret_word.architecture: React UI with localized game logic; minimal dependencies; clear separation of rules vs presentation.
secret_word.decision: Keep game rules testable and UI predictable before adding animations or sound.

tasks-flask-crud.framing: Study case: task CRUD API to practice REST verbs, validation, and persistence boundaries.
tasks-flask-crud.architecture: Flask service with relational storage; explicit request/response contracts.
tasks-flask-crud.decision: Model errors and status codes explicitly — front-end consumers depend on stable semantics.

sample-flask-auth.framing: Study case: authentication sample — login, tokens, and protected routes on a small Flask API.
sample-flask-auth.architecture: Session or token middleware; hashed credentials; route guards on sensitive endpoints.
sample-flask-auth.decision: Treat auth as a cross-cutting contract, not a one-off route handler.

HTML-CSS.framing: Study case: layout and responsive CSS without a framework — spacing, grid, and typography discipline.
HTML-CSS.architecture: Semantic HTML structure; mobile-first breakpoints; reusable utility classes.
HTML-CSS.decision: Master layout fundamentals before leaning on component libraries.
